description: This file contains unit tests for the MainViewModel class of an Android application. It uses JUnit and Robolectric to test the behavior of methods related to navigation item generation and error handling.

classes.name: MainViewModelTest
classes.description: A test class for MainViewModel, validating navigation item generation and error filtering.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes context and reflection method for testing.

methods.name: fromCategoriesWithNotesCount_nothing_expanded
methods.description: Tests navigation items generated from categories with no expanded category.

methods.name: fromCategoriesWithNotesCount_Bar_expanded
methods.description: Tests navigation item generation with 'Bar' category expanded.

methods.name: fromCategoriesWithNotesCount_invalid_expanded
methods.description: Tests behavior when an invalid category is expanded.

methods.name: fromCategoriesWithNotesCount_subcategory_expanded
methods.description: Tests handling of subcategory expansion, which should be treated like unknown.

methods.name: fromCategoriesWithNotesCount_only_deep_category_without_favorites
methods.description: Tests navigation for a deep category without favorites.

methods.name: containsNonInfrastructureRelatedItems
methods.description: Validates filtering of non-infrastructure related error items.
